patterns.note: Large, whimsical isometric illustrations are used as full-width background elements that content scrolls over, creating a layered, parallax-like effect.
A sophisticated, elegant serif font is used for main headings, providing a strong visual contrast with the clean sans-serif used for body text and subheadings.
A soft, pastel color palette dominates the illustrations, complemented by a predominantly light background and a distinct light blue for interactive elements and accents.
Key background illustrations (hero cityscape, footer islands) exhibit a parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement.
Sections feature alternating background treatments, some with solid pastel colors and others with integrated, custom isometric illustrations that extend across the full width.

technique_notes: The site integrates large, detailed isometric illustrations as background elements that are either fixed or scroll at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a parallax scrolling effect. This is likely achieved using GSAP ScrollTrigger to control the background's position relative to the scroll progress.

Content sections and their internal elements are revealed using scroll-triggered animations (likely GSAP) that apply a subtle fade-in and upward translation as they enter the viewport, ensuring a smooth and engaging content flow.

The overall visual identity is built upon a clean, minimal layout framework that is elevated by the consistent application of custom, highly detailed isometric illustrations, which serve as both decorative and informative elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body size) with generous line height, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (approx. 4-8px) for buttons, input fields, and card-like elements, contributing to a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and open, with significant vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around text blocks, creating a clean and uncluttered presentation.

standout: The distinctive and consistent use of intricate, pastel-colored isometric illustrations that are integrated into the page layout as large background elements, creating a unique sense of depth and a strong, playful brand identity.
